title: The US Central Command says US military forces are using a range of AI tools to quickly manage enormous amounts of data for operations against Iran (Katrina Manson/Bloomberg)
summary: Katrina Manson / Bloomberg: The US Central Command says US military forces are using a range of AI tools to quickly manage enormous amounts of data for operations against Iran — US military forces are turning to a range of artificial intelligence tools to quickly manage enormous amounts of data for operations against Iran …
